review.scope: Five authored synthetic fixture states with pinned Arial family resolving to LiberationSans-Bold for semibold chrome, captured with Playwright 1.65.1 and Chromium 159.0.8154.6 in the CI container image. lr-scroller now pads its content's inline ends by the focus-ring room so the first and last items' focus rings stay inside the clipped viewport; the follow-up suggestion chip, rendered inside that scroller, therefore sits 3px further from the row's inline start. That chip box is the only changed region in every state (identical 1421-pixel difference within x 24-156, y 668-708); idle and reset remain byte-identical to each other. Each PNG was inspected against the previous baseline before retention. This is a regression baseline, not a design or accessibility qualification.
